subject: QuantumMed — private connectivity, legal handoff & sysops checklist
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moore <amoore@quantummed.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: QuantumMed private connectivity kick-off / initial checklist

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the time yesterday. As discussed, attached is the Redwood on‑prem install checklist and a first-pass network diagram so your infra and security teams have a view of the expected touchpoints. Key items we need to confirm this week:

- VPC peering and route propagation (CIDR ranges and whether you prefer transitive peering via a hub VPC)
- Private endpoints (which services should be private: inference API, metrics/observability, artifact registry)
- Firewall egress rules and allowed ports (we generally require TLS 443 + port 22 for initial agent install)
- KMS/HSM integration options (BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys)
- Maintenance window constraints for initial package install and kernel-level tuning (30–90 minute window)

I copied Marissa (CS lead) and Karthik (network eng) to start a short internal thread for any prechecks on our side.

Please send over the names/emails for the SRE folks who will own the peering VPNs and a scanned copy of your vendor onboarding form if you have one — that will speed the procurement/legal handoff.

Attaching:
- redwood_onprem_install_checklist.xlsx (attachment)
- quantummed_network_diagram_v1.pdf (attachment)

Best,
Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0183

----
I attached the install checklist and a simplified network diagram to give your team context. This is the first of a short series of operational checklists we push before any on‑prem/edge install.
From: Alex Moore <amoore@quantummed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Dina Patel <dina.patel@quantummed.com>, sre@quantummed.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 12:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuantumMed private connectivity kick-off / initial checklist

Thanks, Irene — this is very helpful. Attaching our internal network inventory and a high-level KMS requirements worksheet. Quick answers:

- We prefer peering via our hub VPC (non-transitive) — CIDR: 10.20.0.0/16.
- Private endpoints: yes for inference API + metrics. Artifact registry can be internet-backed for now.
- Firewall: we'll open 443 outbound to Redwood IP ranges and will allow SSH from our jump hosts during the install window.
- KMS: we need BYOK; will need an HSM-backed key with FIPS 140-2 attestation.
- Maintenance window: we can offer Sat 05/16 02:00–05:00 UTC for the initial agent installation.

I attached: quantummed_infra_inventory.xlsx (attachment), quantummed_kms_requirements.xlsx (attachment).

I'll loop in Vijay (sre@quantummed.com) separately with the diagram and to set up a transient VPN test.

Cheers,
Alex Moore
Infrastructure Lead — QuantumMed
amoore@quantummed.com

----
Onboarding documents attached: our infra inventory and KMS spec. We have an internal procurement step too; Dina will coordinate the MOU/PO on her side.
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: QuantumMed — immediate network asks and owners (do not forward)

Marissa / Karthik — quick internal sync: Alex prefers hub VPC peering (10.20.0.0/16) and BYOK via HSM. They propose a Sat maintenance window 05/16 02:00–05:00 UTC.

Please confirm:
- Karthik: can our on‑prem agent support HSM-backed customer keys during initial bootstrap, and what configuration steps will we need to document for their security team? I want a one‑page runbook.
- Marissa: procurement/legal — do we have a standard MOU that covers BYOK and on‑prem support SLAs? If not, can you pull a short addendum template?

Suggested next actions:
1) Karthik drafts a one-page runbook for HSM/BYOK bootstrap and lists any ports or certs we require.
2) Marissa drafts a one-page MOU addendum and shares any standard redline we expect.
3) I will schedule the technical hands‑on call with QuantumMed SRE for Wed (5/13) PST.

Thanks — keep responses short, we want to align before the maintenance window.

Irene
From: Dina Patel <dina.patel@quantummed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: Amoore@quantummed.com, sre@quantummed.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuantumMed private connectivity kick-off / initial checklist

Irene / Marissa — thanks. A couple of compliance asks from our side before the install:

- Can Redwood provide SOC 2 evidence for the agent components that will run in our VPC and any attestation for kernel modules?
- For BYOK: we need a documented key rotation plan and proof of zero key persistence on Redwood-managed systems. If you have a standard diagram/statement, please share.
- Please confirm whether the agent will collect host metadata (instance id, tags) and what telemetry is sent back to Redwood’s observability stack. We can allow metrics but not raw logs.

We'll plan to complete our procurement form once Marissa shares the MOU addendum and the DocuSign link.

Best,
Dina Patel
Head of Procurement, QuantumMed
dina.patel@quantummed.com
+1 617-555-0232
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moore <amoore@quantummed.com>, Dina Patel <dina.patel@quantummed.com>, sre@quantummed.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuantumMed private connectivity kick-off / initial checklist

All — quick update and action list after internal alignment:

1) Karthik attached a one‑page HSM/BYOK bootstrap runbook (see Drive link) and called out two required items: 22 (SSH) from their jump host and 443 outbound to Redwood private endpoint during bootstrap. We will not persist any customer keys on Redwood-managed infra; the agent performs an ephemeral key exchange and stores only a KMS reference.

2) Marissa drafted the MOU addendum (DocuSign link below). It contains the BYOK clause and the limited data telemetry statement (metrics only; no raw host logs). Please review and sign so procurement can issue the PO.

3) Scheduled technical call: Wed 05/13 15:00–16:00 PDT (invitation sent) — agenda: VPN handshake test, agent bootstrap demo, and confirm peering routes.

Links & attachments:
- Runbook (one-page): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Qm_QuantumMed_Onboarding
- MOU (DocuSign): https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-quantummed-mou
- Attachments: redwood_onprem_install_checklist.xlsx, quantummed_network_diagram_v1.pdf

Next steps for QuantumMed: please have your SRE on the Wed call and sign the MOU before the Saturday maintenance window. If any of these items look off, reply with a short note.

Thanks — looking forward to the run.

Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: redwood_onprem_install_checklist.xlsx (checklist), quantummed_network_diagram_v1.pdf (diagram), quantummed_kms_requirements.xlsx (client KMS spec).
